crypto_headlines.title: Strategy adds 1,036 BTC, now holds 850,364 BTC
crypto_headlines.summary: Michael Saylor said Strategy acquired 1,036 BTC and repurchased $188 million of its STRC preferred stock. As of Nov 8, the company holds 850,364 BTC and $4.9 billion of USD assets.

crypto_headlines.title: Coinbase gets a full U.S. national trust bank charter
crypto_headlines.summary: Cointelegraph reported that Coinbase secured a full national trust bank charter from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. Brian Armstrong said trusted custody is essential for bringing more of the financial system onchain.

crypto_headlines.title: NYSE to settle tokenized stock trades on Avalanche
crypto_headlines.summary: Citing the Wall Street Journal, Cointelegraph reported that the NYSE will use Avalanche to settle tokenized stock trades on its planned 24/7 trading platform.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance says no evidence of a breach behind 335M-record claim
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance said it found no evidence of a breach and called ShinyHunters' claim of 335 million stolen user records a likely scam, per Cointelegraph.

crypto_headlines.title: Ankr's Ethereum bridge hit by an exploit
crypto_headlines.summary: Cointelegraph, citing Blockaid, reported an ongoing exploit that had drained about $292K from Ankr's Ethereum bridge.

crypto_headlines.title: Big macro week: October CPI Tuesday, PPI Friday
crypto_headlines.summary: This week's calendar includes October CPI on Tuesday, the OPEC monthly report Wednesday, jobless claims and existing home sales Thursday, October PPI Friday, and 17 Fed speaker events.

doginal_news.title: Vee opens the door for Doginal Dogs creators ahead of Miami
doginal_news.summary: Community member CryptoGrannyNo5 posted that Vee (@veemeta) used her Space to invite every Doginal Dogs creator to brand, build, and play, with Miami as the target.

doginal_news.title: Doginal Dogs Legends online beta is free to play
doginal_news.summary: Community member AnTheM described Doginal Dogs Legends as a free-to-play online digital TCG beta: 40-card decks (max 3 copies) of creatures, spells and traps across five classes (Wizard, Crown, Zombie, Bow, Pirate), with heroes starting at 40 HP.

doginal_news.title: Pyth sponsors a CSN Space with the Doginal Dogs crowd
doginal_news.summary: Rollmeta promoted Bailey's CSN Space "Crypto Wizardry Things," sponsored by Pyth Network, tagging Doginal Dogs and Dogwarts DAO.

doginal_news.title: Community: 1,944 stable price feeds and 90 indices in the Pyth catalogue
doginal_news.summary: Community member asterturtle said the Pyth catalogue now lists 1,944 stable price feeds and 90 stable indices, all reachable through the Pyth Terminal.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs, @DDLTCG, @PythNetwork, or @thePIRB in the last ~24 hours (replies only). No floor update and no news on Toot, Atlas, or Boogie. Catalogue numbers are a community count, not an official Pyth post. Watch out for posts pushing PYTH 'eligibility checkers' or wallet-connect airdrops.
